meta.notes: Pixel 562761383897004 available. Yesterday was 286 purchases and 122 checkouts on $10,580 spend, down 24% vs the 7d avg, in line with Shopify. EMQ is 9.2 for Purchase (99% CAPI coverage) and 8.4 for InitiateCheckout (94%). No duplicate event names. Platform-reported.

google.notes: Primary 'Google Shopping App Purchase' was 36.5 on 10/25, 62% below its 7d avg, while Shopify was down only 28%. Spend held flat at about $2.0k/day, so platform ROAS fell from about 7.4x on 10/18 to 1.7x on 10/25. All conversion actions are enabled and still recording, including GA4 purchase, Elevar server-side and enhanced. The GA4 purchase import fell only 31 vs 43 avg, roughly matching Shopify. Shopping App page views also halved on the same spend. That points to either the Google & YouTube app tag under-firing or a real traffic or quality drop, plus some click-date lag on the latest days. Not a hard outage. Owner: Google · Ads.

bing.notes: UET tag 134596770 is Active. The goal 'Grok Bot | Purchase (UET event, revenue)' is Active and RecordingConversions. The Shopify campaigns only started 10/25, so there's no 7d baseline yet. No begin-checkout goal is active (the old ones are paused), so checkout events aren't tracked. The legacy 'ShopifyImport' tag 211021853 is inactive, but no active goal uses it. The 'bing to amz tumbler listing 1' campaign (about $70/day) sends to Amazon and isn't tracked by design.

google.notes: Primary 'Google Shopping App Purchase' was 36.5 on 10/25, 62% below its 7d avg, while Shopify was down only 28%. Spend held flat at about $2.0k/day, so platform ROAS fell from about 7.4x on 10/18 to 1.7x on 10/25. All conversion actions are enabled and still recording, including GA4 purchase, Elevar server-side and enhanced. The GA4 purchase import fell only 31 vs 43 avg, roughly matching Shopify. Shopping App page views also halved on the same spend. That points to either the Google & YouTube app tag under-firing or a real traffic or quality drop, plus some click-date lag on the latest days. Not a hard outage. Owner: Google · Ads.

bing.notes: UET tag 134596770 is Active. The goal 'Grok Bot | Purchase (UET event, revenue)' is Active and RecordingConversions.
